description: This file defines the PayGradeService class, which provides various methods for managing pay grades, currencies, and related data within the Human Resource Management system. It interacts with the data access layer (PayGradeDao), performs data normalization, and exposes functionalities such as retrieving, saving, and deleting pay grades and currencies.

classes.name: PayGradeService
classes.description: Service class for managing pay grades and related currencies, providing business logic and data access coordination within the HRM system.

methods.name: getPayGradeDao
methods.description: Lazy loads or initializes the PayGradeDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: setPayGradeDao
methods.description: Sets the PayGradeDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its identifier.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Fetches a list of pay grades based on optional filter parameters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Gets a list of currencies associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Returns a list of pay grade currencies filtered by provided criteria.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of pay grade currencies matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a specific PayGradeCurrency by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: isValidSalaryAmountForPayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Validates if a salary amount falls within the min and max salary bounds for a specific currency and pay grade.

methods.name: getPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Provides a normalized array of pay period data.

methods.name: getPayGradeArray
methods.description: Provides a normalized array of pay grade data.

methods.name: getCurrencyArray
methods.description: Provides a normalized array of currency data.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Fetches a currency type entity by its ID.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persists a pay grade entity to the database.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Persists a pay grade currency entity.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades by their IDs.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies that are allowed for a given pay grade or filter criteria.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of allowed pay currencies matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes specific pay grade currencies associated with a pay grade.
